components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action color; used for Donasi Sekarang, Lanjut, Bayar Sekarang, and chat send.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; background:#0D9488; color:#fff; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:15px; line-height:1.2; padding:13px 26px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), transform .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#0F766E; box-shadow:0 10px 24px -10px rgba(13,148,136,.55); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0D9488; outline-offset:3px; border-radius:999px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action; hairline border that turns teal on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:transparent; color:#0F172A; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:15px; line-height:1.2; padding:13px 26px; border:1px solid #CBD5E1; border-radius:999px; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:#0D9488; color:#0F766E; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0D9488; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Preset Amount Tile
components.description: Donation amount preset; soft fill that fills teal once selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { background:#F1F5F9; border:1.5px solid #E2E8F0; color:#0F172A; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:15px; padding:14px; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), background-color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:#0D9488; } .ds-chip.selected { background:#0D9488; border-color:#0D9488; color:#fff; }

components.name: Campaign Card
components.description: White card with a gradient cover glyph, funding bar, and the single action.
components.html: Beasiswa Anak Yatim & Dhuafa
components.css: .ds-card { position:relative; background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column; transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow .22s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), border-color .18s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:0 18px 44px -16px rgba(15,23,42,.18); } .ds-cover { aspect-ratio:16/9; background:linear-gradient(140deg,#0D9488,#134E4A); } .ds-card h3 { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:18px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.02em; line-height:1.3; margin:0 0 14px; } .ds-track { height:8px; border-radius:999px; background:#F1F5F9; overflow:hidden; } .ds-fill { height:100%; border-radius:999px; background:#0D9488; }

components.name: Pay Method Tile
components.description: Payment-method option in step 3; white icon tile in a soft field.
components.css: .ds-pay { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; background:#F1F5F9; border:1.5px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:10px; padding:13px 14px; cursor:pointer; font:inherit; text-align:left; transition:border-color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), background-color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-pay:hover { border-color:#0D9488; } .ds-pay.selected { border-color:#0D9488; background:#CCFBF1; } .ds-pay-icon { width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:9px; display:grid; place-items:center; background:#fff; border:1px solid #E2E8F0; color:#0D9488; }

components.name: Nav
components.description: Fixed white bar on a hairline; teal heart mark; shadow-sm once scrolled.
components.html: Markas KebaikanProgramKampanyeTransparansi
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:26px; height:64px; padding:0 24px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.92); border-bottom:1px solid #E2E8F0; } .ds-nav-brand { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:18px; letter-spacing:-.02em; color:#0F172A; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-mark { width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #2DD4BF, #0D9488 60%); } .ds-nav a:not(.ds-nav-brand) { color:#475569; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; margin-left:auto; } .ds-nav a:not(.ds-nav-brand):hover { color:#0F172A; }

components.name: Chat Chip
components.description: Suggestion chips in the AI chat; hairline pill, teal hover.
components.css: .ds-chat-chip { background:#F1F5F9; border:1px solid #CBD5E1; color:#0F172A; font:inherit; font-size:12.5px; padding:7px 12px; border-radius:999px; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-chat-chip:hover { border-color:#0D9488; color:#0F766E; }

narrative.overview: A sedekah platform that feels like a bright, sunlit courtyard — warm, trustworthy, and effortless. The world is slate paper (#F8FAFC) with white cards on 1px hairlines, one teal accent (#0D9488) that only ever points at an action, and amber (#D97706) reserved for warmth and highlights. It refuses the dark-neon crowdfunding template and the metric-scrum hero. Density stays low: generous section padding, one idea per section, short lines. The system earns trust through restraint: a flat resting state, elevation only on hover, a type scale with obvious steps (Plus Jakarta Sans display over Inter body), and numerals that always line up. Motion is authored once (the funding bars, the stats count-up) rather than sprinkled as entrances everywhere.
keyCharacteristics: Slate paper surfaces on 1px hairlines; elevation only as a hover response.
One teal accent reserved for actions; amber belongs to warmth and highlights.
Plus Jakarta Sans display over an Inter body; headings always balanced.
One authored motion moment; everything else transitions on state.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only interactive color. It marks actions, focus, and the active state of the funding meter; it never decorates a heading or a background.

rules.name: The Amber Warmth Rule
rules.body: Amber is for warmth and highlights — trust checks, urgency, and the hot campaign badge — never for primary actions.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every numeral that can be compared — funding totals, donatur counts, percent, days, prices, chat timestamps — uses tabular-nums so columns and updates never jitter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A card at rest is hairline-on-paper. Shadows are earned by hover, focus, or being an overlay; they never sit under a resting card with its border.

dos: Do keep one accent color (teal) for all interactive elements and reserve amber for warmth and highlights.
Do use tabular-nums for every comparable numeral.
Do balance all headings and keep the display weight at 800.
Do prefer a flat resting state with a hairline border; earn elevation on hover.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: collapse all animation and transition durations.
donts: Don't use gradient text, glass blur, or neon glows — emphasis comes from weight, size, and the teal accent.
Don't add entrance animations on every section; one authored moment (the funding fill and stats count-up) is the motion budget.
Don't use emoji or unicode glyphs as icons — inline SVG in one consistent stroke.
Don't place a kicker/eyebrow above headings; headings carry their own weight.
Don't use soft shadows and a 1px border on the same resting card.
